mentions.name: UkulelExplorer
mentions.description: An app for exploring the ukulele fretboard with custom tunings, aimed at showing the ukulele can be a versatile instrument through exploration of alternative tunings.
mentions.problem: Because of its small body size and having four strings, people often think of ukulele as a toy rather than an instrument; the author believes exploring custom tunings can make it quite versatile.
mentions.source_excerpt: UkulelExplorer https://github.com/hallvaaw/UkulelExplorer - An app for exploring the ukulele fretboard with custom tunings. Because of its small body size and having four strings, people often think of ukulele as a toy rather than an instrument. I believe that by exploring and finding custom tunings, the ukulele can be a quite versatile instrument.
